Class MessageDispatcher

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.galaxy_trucker.server.controller.MessageDispatcher
public class MessageDispatcher extends Object
The MessageDispatcher is responsible for sending messages between the server and connected clients via their associated VirtualView.

It uses the provided Map linking each VirtualView to its Player to determine where to send messages. It supports broadcasting messages to all players, to all players except one, or to a specific player by name.
